name: remotetab
description: RemoteTab: control one Chrome tab from a paired phone PWA over WebRTC.

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:signaling && bun run typecheck:extension
scripts.typecheck:packages: tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p packages/crypto && tsc --noEmit -p packages/webrtc && tsc --noEmit -p packages/config && tsc --noEmit -p packages/testkit
scripts.typecheck:extension: cd apps/extension && bun run prepare:types && bunx tsc --noEmit -p .
